comment: He's very passionate about Physics, and he is kind

Dr. Gilfoyle is a hilarious guy who takes time to get to know his students. He is old-school where he only teaches the overall topic and a few questions, but expects you to learn how to approach other problems from HW answer keys or office hours. But, his tests are very fair and offers lots of partial credit. He's a professor to grab a beer with.

I have no idea what people complain about. He is a great teacher who takes the time to make sure everyone understands what's going on before moving on. The pacing of the lectures is perfect and the labs aren't bad either. This material can be tough. There's no HW (optional) but the quizzes are pulled directly from the HW. Tests very similar to HW.

Dr. Gilfoyle is a good dude, but this class is pretty poor. He usually does a derivative of some physics law on the board, and then we do a lab. The lectures are always more confusing than helpful. I did better in Orgo 1 and 2 than in this class because studying felt impossible. That said, he is a funny guy and very approachable.

Dr. Gilfoyle leaves students to learn the concepts and homework problems by themselves. Tests are very difficult and count a lot towards your grade. But overall, he is a nice guy, and the class is manageable to an extent.
